Taglia-cinture

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Taglia-cinture?

In this glossary, Taglia-cinture refers to: Knife-type tool with guarded blade carried in cockpit or cabin to sever jammed seat-belts during emergency evacuation or rescue.

How is Taglia-cinture used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Cockpit a cabina: taglia-cinture richiesto fila 22 sinistra, cintura bloccata e passeggero non può evacuare; inviare equipaggio addestrato subito."

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

Knife-type tool with guarded blade carried in cockpit or cabin to sever jammed seat-belts during emergency evacuation or rescue.

Operational example

Flight deck to cabin: seat-belt cutter required at row 22 left, belt jammed and passenger unable to evacuate; dispatch trained crew immediately.
